title: GPU-less, Trust-less, Limit-less: Reimagining the Confidential AI Cloud - Mike Bursell

primary.label: Security, Safety, Identity & Governance

domains.label: General Purpose
domains.rationale: The talk's primary focus is securing AI systems through confidential computing, TEEs, cryptographic attestation, and on-chain verifiable governance. Super Protocol is a developer platform for confidential AI with prominent healthcare applications including FDA audit compliance and multi-party medical model training. The talk covers model deployment via marketplace, distributed vLLM inference across GPU nodes, and multi-party confidential training for medical applications. Requires understanding of confidential computing, TEEs, and blockchain but remains accessible to AI infrastructure practitioners. Conference presentation featuring four live technical demonstrations and two quantitative case studies. Multiple transcript evidence anchors directly support the security and governance classification with specific technical claims and quantitative case study results.

summary:
The talk introduces Confidential AI as the solution to trust barriers preventing AI adoption with sensitive data and proprietary models. The foundation is confidential computing via Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs)—hardware-isolated processor regions (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, Nvidia GPU TEEs) that protect code and data during execution, invisible even to hardware owners. TEEs generate cryptographic attestation proving workloads ran in verified hardware with unmodified code, enabling both isolation and verifiable provenance.

Real-world problems include healthcare data locked behind months of negotiation, personal AI agents needing deep private data access, digital marketing blocked by GDPR/CCPA, model monetization hampered by mutual distrust, and provenance assurance for trained models. Traditional clouds fail because they rely on trust and contracts rather than provable guarantees.

Super Protocol is a confidential AI cloud and marketplace: TEE-agnostic, edge-ready (ARM CCA validated), swarm-computing-based with no single point of failure, fully decentralized via BNB chain smart contracts, and open source as a protocol. 'GPU-less' removes provider dependency, 'trust-less' means no unauthorized access is technically possible, and 'limit-less' removes legal, technical, and organizational barriers.

Two case studies demonstrate impact. Realize, analyzing facial expressions for Mars, gained 4x more footage and 319% larger training sets with 75% accuracy and 3-5% sales increases across 30 brands in 19 markets. BEAL, racing to submit an epilepsy diagnostic device to the FDA, used Titonic's AI audit tool on Super Protocol—cutting audit time from 2-4 weeks to 1-2 hours with zero leak risk and no 120-day re-review delays.

Four demos follow. The Super AI Marketplace demo shows one-click model deployment (DeepSeek on H100) with on-chain verification. The n8n healthcare demo builds an automated X-ray analysis workflow inside a TEE. The distributed vLLM demo partitions a 22B-parameter Mistral LLM across four GPU nodes in confidential mode with encrypted inter-node communication, on-chain reports verifying integrity for all participants, and a public endpoint with faster parallelized responses.

The fourth demo shows multi-party medical training: Alice's lab and Bob's clinic hold sensitive datasets; Carol provides a proprietary training engine for early cancer detection. A confidential VM (CVM) launched once handles multiple jobs, contacting an open-source certification authority for remote attestation. A trusted loader inside the CVM is independently attested, creates a signed key pair, and checks every component hash—blocking execution if anything diverges. Data is encrypted via SPCTL and only the designated CVM can decrypt it. Training runs fully inside the TEE; only Carol receives the encrypted trained model. On-chain order reports provide public, tamper-proof evidence of what ran, with which inputs, on which hardware—replacing NDAs and manual audits with cryptographic verifiability.

sections.title: Introduction & The Trust Problem
sections.summary: AI is transforming industries but trust is the blocker. Running models on sensitive data, deploying proprietary models, and collaborating in non-deterministic environments all require moving beyond blind trust. Confidential AI solves this, and Super Protocol makes it real.

sections.title: Confidential Computing & Trusted Execution Environments
sections.summary: Data and models are most vulnerable during processing, not storage or transit. TEEs (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP, Nvidia GPU TEEs) create isolated confidential environments in the processor, protecting code and data even from hardware owners. TEEs generate cryptographic attestation proving the workload ran in verified hardware with unmodified code.

sections.title: Real-World Problems Confidential AI Solves
sections.summary: Five problem areas: healthcare data access blocked by regulation and silos; personal AI agents needing deep private data access; digital marketing constrained by privacy laws; model monetization blocked by mutual distrust over IP and data; and provenance assurance for trained models. Traditional clouds fail because they rely on trust and contracts, not provable guarantees.

sections.title: Super Protocol Overview: GPU-less, Trust-less, Limit-less
sections.summary: Super Protocol is a confidential AI cloud and marketplace built for secure collaboration and monetization. It is TEE-agnostic, edge-ready (ARM CCA validated), swarm-computing-based with no single point of failure, fully decentralized via BNB chain smart contracts, and open source as a protocol. GPU-less removes provider dependency, trust-less means no unauthorized access is technically possible, limit-less removes legal, technical, and organizational barriers.

sections.title: Case Study: Realize & Mars (Digital Marketing)
sections.summary: Realize uses AI to analyze facial expressions for brands like Coca-Cola and Mars but needed more biometric data. Privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA) blocked data sharing. Using Super Protocol with Nvidia H100/H200 and Intel Xeon TEEs and smart-contract automation, providers shared 4x more footage, growing training sets by 319%. Accuracy reached 75% (human-level), driving 3-5% sales increases across 30 Mars brands in 19 markets.

sections.title: Case Study: BEAL & FDA Audit (Healthcare)
sections.summary: BEAL (Brain Electrophysiology Laboratory) raced to submit an epilepsy diagnostic device to the FDA, a process normally requiring 2-4 weeks of manual audits, multiple NDAs, and risk of exposing trade secrets—with mistakes causing 120-day delays. Titonic's AI-powered audit tool ran on Super Protocol's confidential AI cloud using Nvidia H100/H200 GPUs and Intel TDX CPUs. All files and models stayed encrypted inside TEEs, hidden from all parties. Audit time dropped to 1-2 hours with zero leak risk, fully protected IP, and no re-review delays.

sections.title: Demo 1: Super AI Marketplace & Confidentiality Check
sections.summary: The Super AI Marketplace is built on a confidential, decentralized architecture with no centralized components. Blockchain manages relationships and financial settlements between model/data providers, hardware providers, and clients. Models are leased but not downloaded—nobody accesses the TEE during processing. The demo deploys a DeepSeek model on an H100 GPU via blockchain-orchestrated order creation (~20 minutes). A verification tool confirms the model runs in a confidential environment with encrypted connection and untampered AI engine.

sections.title: Demo 2: n8n Healthcare AI Workflow
sections.summary: An n8n workflow runs inside a TEE on Super Protocol to process sensitive medical data. A doctor uploads an X-ray and patient data via a protected web form. The workflow separates personal data from diagnostic input, sends only the X-ray and symptoms to an AI model, generates a structured medical report (text/HTML/JSON), and emails it securely to the doctor. Credentials (API keys, Gmail) are stored inside the TEE. The solution adapts to CT scans, MRIs, ECGs, and lab tests—all within confidential environments with no functionality-versus-privacy tradeoff.

sections.title: Demo 3: Distributed vLLM Inference
sections.summary: Super Protocol secures distributed vLLM inference across multiple GPU servers. vLLM partitions models by layers across nodes; Super Protocol runs every node inside a confidential VM with TEE hardware over a private overlay network. The demo uses four host owners (Alice, Bob, Carol, David) with H100/H200 GPUs running a 22B-parameter Mistral LLM. SPCTL uploads Docker images to decentralized storage. On-chain reports verify image and model hashes for all four participants, each passing integrity checks. A public endpoint allows anyone to test and make requests, with faster responses due to parallelized processing across four machines.

sections.title: Demo 4: Provable Medical-Data Training & On-Chain Reporting
sections.summary: Three participants—Alice's lab, Bob's clinic, Carol's research center—train an early cancer detection model without exposing data or IP. Alice and Bob hold encrypted datasets on their own decentralized storage; Carol provides a proprietary container-based training engine whose source code is privately shared for verification. A CVM (launched once for multiple jobs) contacts an open-source certification authority for remote attestation. A trusted loader inside the CVM is independently attested, creates a signed key pair, and checks every component hash—blocking execution if anything diverges. Only the designated CVM (ID 8) can decrypt the data. Training runs fully inside the TEE; only Carol receives the encrypted trained model and artifacts. On-chain order reports provide public, tamper-proof evidence including certificates, processed input hashes, and timing.

sections.title: Conclusion & Recap
sections.summary: The session recapped real-world problems, case studies in digital marketing and healthcare, and four demos showing confidential AI in practice: running models on private data without exposure, deploying proprietary models without losing control, fine-tuning without compliance risk, and verifying execution with cryptographic proof. Super Protocol is simple to use, transparent, secure by design—GPU-less, trust-less, limit-less. Viewers are invited to launch models in confidential environments and explore the website, marketplace, documentation, and Nvidia's article.
